summary: Saved exploration: toggling Compact View resets group_by order and severs trace anchors
description: Issue summary: A customer reports that a saved exploration (ad-hoc dashboard) changes its group_by ordering when the user toggles the dashboard 'Compact View' control. The ordering change results in trace links (trace anchors) embedded in rows to point to the wrong query cursor / trace context. Impact: Customers lose the ability to reliably click from a dashboard row to the corresponding trace; exports may have mismatched anchors. Occurs intermittently when the exploration contains multi-column group_by and nested aggregations.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Login to Console as user with org scoped API key (FinOptima test-org).
2) Open saved exploration 'revenue_stream_distributions_v2' (publicly shared in the org).
3) Ensure the view is set to Expanded (default) and sort is by group_by[0] then group_by[1].
4) Click the 'Compact View' toggle in the top-right of the panel to switch to compact mode.
5) Observe that the visible sort order reverts to a different group_by sequence and row-level 'View Trace' links open trace pages that do not match the row's timestamp or request_id.
6) Toggle back to Expanded view to confirm the order persists incorrectly and trace anchors continue to resolve to different traces.
logs: Frontend console (client): Uncaught TypeError at dashboard-view: undefined comparator for group_by sequence (stack trace attached).
Query service: query-cursor mismatch observed in logs: cursor_id=abc123 resolved to request_id=fx-92 while row metadata request_id=fx-17
Trace service link generation: anchor_hash computed from serialized group_by array (order-dependent) - hash mismatch when UI reorders fields.
investigation_notes: 03/13 14:22 UTC - Reproduced in staging with FinOptima dataset. Compact View uses a different client-side serialization that normalizes group_by into a sorted map. This transforms the order used to compute trace anchor tokens.
Hypothesis: compact view normalization breaks stable ordering assumption relied on by trace-anchor generation (anchor computed client-side using group_by order).
03/13 16:05 UTC - Confirmed server-side does not re-order group_by on save; problem arises during client render path and when making the ad-hoc export request for anchors.
Potential root cause: compact view component imports a utility (normalizeColumns) that returns keys in alphabetical order; previously anchor code expected insertion order.
comments: Support (Maya): Notified customer and requested temp workaround - avoid toggling Compact View and use 'Export CSV' if they need stable anchors (customer accepted workaround).
Customer (FinOptima - product ops): We see this on multiple saved explorations and it impacts our incident troubleshooting flow. Happy to provide session replay or org-level access for debugging.
SRE (Liam): Reproduced in staging, created minimal test case. Adding @frontend-team for fix. Linking to frontend PR once ready.

Frontend (Ana Rodrigues): Found the normalizeColumns import. Will change anchor computation to use server-supplied canonical_group_by order (fall back to insertion order). Preparing PR to fix client-side anchor hash generation.
Engineering Lead (Rohit Patel): Prioritize for next patch release; P1 due to enterprise customer impact and loss of traceability. Coordinate release with rolling deploy to avoid console 500s.
resolution: Workaround: Customer advised not to toggle Compact View; use Export CSV for stable anchors or open individual row details. Permanent fix: Frontend PR merged to compute anchor hashes from server-provided canonical_group_by ordering (or fallback to saved ordering when canonical absent). Patch rolled to staging 2026-03-14 and scheduled for prod release 2026-03-16 with a small feature-flag. Follow-up: Add unit tests for serialization order and add end-to-end test covering Compact View toggles.
